tokens.name: tari-ink
tokens.usage: Public Tari brand ink. The Jam mark's tile; deepest ground for brand moments and launch art.

tokens.name: tari-cloud
tokens.usage: Public Tari brand cloud. Mark's first stroke and emphasised text on tari-ink (17.2:1) or the lobby trail.

tokens.name: tari-purple
tokens.usage: Public Tari brand purple. Mark outline, glows and large display fills. Not for small text on dark grounds: 3.66:1 on tari-ink, 3.59:1 on page.

tokens.name: tari-green
tokens.usage: Public Tari electric green (the app's --game-lime). Mark's second stroke, highlighted words in headlines (h1 span/em), lobby trail links. 14.5:1 on tari-ink.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page ground under the body's faint purple radial glow (Shell/HubMotion override of bg).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Original base background; inputs set inside quick search and the header's translucent fill.

tokens.name: bg-elev
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, filters, search field, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-elev-2
tokens.usage: Second elevation: fields, badges, tags, media placeholders, bar tracks, toasts.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards, panels, header and section dividers. Decorative only (1.23:1 on bg-elev). High contrast: 3.7:1 or better, so surfaces separate by border, not shade.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders on buttons, fields, badges. Below 3:1 on bg-elev (1.51:1) — kept exact from source; focus relies on the lime ring. High contrast: 6.8:1 or better on grounds, 5.6:1 on accent-dim — control borders meet 3:1.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on page, bg-elev and bg-elev-2 (14.4:1 or better). High contrast: 18.3:1 or better on page, bg-elev, bg-elev-2.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: ledes, summaries, nav labels, comments. 6.2:1 on bg-elev-2 and above. High contrast: 11.8:1 or better on all three grounds; 9.6:1 on accent-dim.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary meta: card footers, counts, timestamps, filter headings. Fails 4.5:1 (3.3–3.8:1) — kept exact; use only for non-essential metadata. High contrast: lifted to 9.4:1 or better, so metadata passes AAA there.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lavender, the quieter UI accent: active nav/facet text, links, step numbers, spinner. 8.2:1 on accent-dim, 10.1:1 on bg-elev. High contrast: 12.8:1 or better on grounds, 10.4:1 on accent-dim.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Deeper lavender: gradient end on primary buttons and bars, hover and focus borders on cards and fields. High contrast: 8.0:1 or better as a hover/focus border.

tokens.name: accent-dim
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: active nav and facets, notices, external badges, step circles.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on the primary lavender gradient (10.3:1 on accent, 6.75:1 on accent-strong). High contrast: 14.0:1 on accent, 8.7:1 on accent-strong.

tokens.name: lavender-glow
tokens.usage: Hover glows, nav underline gradient start, milestone border and quick-search hover (always used translucent in source).

tokens.name: native
tokens.usage: Tari-native signal: native badges, current freshness, popular tier. 8.5:1 on native-dim. High contrast: 11.3:1 on native-dim.

tokens.name: native-dim
tokens.usage: Ground and border for native badges and the popular tier chip.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Stale or provisional freshness badges. Always with its word label. High contrast: 13.7:1 or better.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Failed or unavailable freshness badges. Always with its word label; differs from native in hue and lightness. High contrast: 9.6:1 or better; still always with its word.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Top popularity tier and a starred StarButton, on gold-dim (11.1:1). High contrast: 12.0:1 on gold-dim.

tokens.name: gold-dim
tokens.usage: Ground for the top tier chip and starred button.

tokens.name: gold-line
tokens.usage: Border for the top tier chip and starred button. High contrast: 4.3:1 on gold-dim.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus-visible outline (2px, offset 4px) on every link, button and field; 14.8:1 on bg-elev. Also burst sparks and milestone glyph.

tokens.name: active-lime
tokens.usage: Insight values, loading gem, the earlier focus ring — electric highlight on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: hero-pink
tokens.usage: End stop of the hero headline's lavender gradient text (.hero .grad).

styles.name: lobby-display
styles.usage: Home lobby h1, clamp(34px, 4.6vw, 66px). Highlight one word in tari-green.

styles.name: h2-section
styles.usage: Section heads; journey heading scales to 36px.

styles.name: h3-card
styles.usage: Card and media-card titles (16px in media cards).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Build it. Break it. Let your friends find out.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick a starter, equip your agent and ship a playable idea.

styles.name: summary
styles.sample: A cozy garden sim where signals grow into plants.
styles.usage: Card summaries in muted, clamped to 3 lines.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Primary nav links; 9px hint line below in muted.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Card footers, timestamps, counts in faint.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kickers above headings (journey-heading small, release-label).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commit hashes and identifiers, in accent.

spacing.note: The source has no spacing variables; these are its recurring literal values, named by where they are used.

tokens.name: space-row

tokens.name: space-grid

tokens.name: space-card

tokens.name: space-gutter

tokens.name: space-section

tokens.name: radius-feature

tokens.name: radius-pill
